ms.report:
Responses to your questions:
・MB: The Reseller education is the realisation of the “The students will engage with various types of decentralisation technologies compatible with the Cardano blockchain, gaining understanding of their usage, societal value, underlying concepts, and acquiring hands-on experience.” section i.e understanding leading to hands-on experience as resellers of the service.
・MB: “SSI specification” is the registered skill in the the Skills section - the skill has a DID that is then linked the learners DID via a Verifiable Credential. I have updated the Skills header to be reflect this and also add “DID” where relevant.
・MB: It is in the design document, but have also separated into a separate document.
